claims.statement: WAKE utilizes a distinct governance module to enforce its operational rulebook mechanically across model invocations.

support.explanation: Explicit declaration of the governance module as the mechanical foundation for operations.

actions.findings: WAKE utilizes a distinct governance module to enforce its operational rulebook mechanically across model invocations. [source-2495945693ad432c]
actions.limitations: Self-referential analysis constrained by visible repository structure; internal logic of the governance module remains partially opaque.
actions.next_questions: How does WAKE's governance module resolve conflicts between stored durable state and external evidence updates?
actions.reason: Synthesis of WAKE's architectural principles based on durable governance evidence.
actions.summary: WAKE functions through a durable governance module that mechanically enforces operational constraints on subsequent invocations, effectively separating rule-based governance from model-based research.
actions.title: Governance as the Mechanical Foundation of WAKE

proposal.summary: Formalizing the WAKE structural model as a governance-constrained, durable research process.
